items.title: Media Generation Landscape
items.author: DataTalksClub ⬛
items.summary:
Module 1, Lesson 1 of the free course Production AI Agents for Media Generation: the landscape of generative AI models. How to pick models, GPUs and licenses for generating images, video and audio, using one running example (personalized holiday cards).

Course: https://github.com/DataTalksClub/production-ai-agents-for-media-generation

0:00 Introduction
0:55 Running example: personalized holiday cards
3:57 Modalities
4:43 Tasks: text-to-image, image-to-video, text-to-speech, text-to-music
6:54 Recording the decision: GPU, cost, self-hosting
8:28 Finding and shortlisting models
11:13 Will the model fit on your GPU?
13:13 Licenses and commercial use
15:14 Closed vs open models: provider risk
17:10 API vs self-hosting
18:05 Consistency and what's next
